authority: Arm-authored test gates; observable fidelity measures for the independently frozen scene, not additional human-requested locks.
evaluation_rule: partial_is_fail; judge original saved pixels; do not infer occluded features. Actual desire, consent and biography are outside these gates.

gates.criterion: The image portrays one clearly adult woman whose visible face proportions, dark bob and wispy bangs remain consistent with the reference. The adult age is authored, not inferred from the source portrait.
prompt_evidence: Her visible face and dark bob with wispy bangs follow the supplied portrait.
an adult woman in her late twenties

gates.criterion: One eye is visibly closed in a wink and the other is visibly open with its gaze directed toward the capture/viewer position. A blink, two closed eyes or an off-target gaze fails.
prompt_evidence: She closes her right eye in a deliberate wink; her open left eye meets the camera.

gates.criterion: One mouth corner visibly lifts into a restrained knowing smile that is compatible with the wink; a neutral, distressed or broad generic laugh fails this intended form.
prompt_evidence: A knowing smile lifts one corner of her lips.

gates.criterion: The free hand is visible in front at chest height, palm up, with the index curling toward the woman in a readable come-closer gesture addressed to the viewer; a wave or hidden finger fails.
prompt_evidence: Her left hand reaches forward at chest height, palm up, with the index finger curling toward herself in a clear come-closer gesture.

gates.criterion: The other hand visibly gathers a plum velvet curtain at roughly shoulder height, with physical finger-fabric contact and a clear doorway beside her. No detached hand, floating fabric or fabric hiding the interaction.
prompt_evidence: Her right hand gathers the plum velvet curtain at shoulder height, keeping the opening clear beside her.

gates.criterion: The shoulders and body are partly turned into the doorway while her face returns toward the viewer; both acting hands and the above-knee-to-head subject are visible in one plausible frame.
prompt_evidence: with her shoulders half-turned into the doorway and her face returned to the viewer
Frame her from above the knees to just above her head, with both hands fully visible.

gates.criterion: A deep-red silk halter mini dress with draped neckline and exposed shoulders is visible, and the velvet threshold contrasts amber interior light with cool blue balcony light. These forms support rather than visually obscure the face-and-hand event.
prompt_evidence: a deep-red silk halter mini dress, its softly draped neckline and bare shoulders catching a warm edge of light
Amber salon light brushes her cheek and the curtain folds; cool blue balcony light defines the opposite edge.

separate_qualitative_assessment: Describe whole-image impression before consulting sensual labels.
Assess whether the combined event feels playfully seductive rather than merely friendly or attractively posed.
Do not equate gaze or gesture with actual desire or consent.
